question: If 649 bananas were distributed among three monkeys in the ratio (1)/(2) : (1)/(6) : (1)/(4) , how many bananas did the first monkey get?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio = 1/2 : 1/6 : 1/4

LCM of (2,6,4) = 12 ⇒ ratio = 6 : 2 : 3

Total parts = 11

First monkey = (6/11) × 649 = 354

**∴ Answer = 354 bananas**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total bananas = 649

Ratio = 1/2 : 1/6 : 1/4

**Calculation:**

⇒ Convert into whole numbers

⇒ Multiply by LCM (12)

⇒ Ratio = 6 : 2 : 3

⇒ Total parts = 6 + 2 + 3 = 11

⇒ First monkey share = (6/11) × 649

⇒ = 354

**∴ The correct answer is 354 bananas.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Conversion

Convert fractional ratios into integers using LCM.

Distribution Rule

Share = (part ÷ total parts) × total quantity.

Quick Tip

Always simplify ratio first before calculating.
